items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Oh man, David was my friend.

ctx.x: We lived in the 1500 block of North Claymore at that time, next to a bar room called Betty's Inn, where I first saw Louis Jordan and the Tempany Five on a Nickelodeon movie thing. You used to put the money in this machine, and it looked like a big television, you know, back in those days.
You know what I said, the same story? David Lasty.
Yeah? Oh man, David was my friend.
